name: Riester and Rürup next to the DRV pension, KVdR
workings: The 40-point DRV pension of drv-pension-tax-2030, and a Rürup annuity of 6,000 (a fixed pension of kind basicPension), both started in 2030; a Riester payout of 6,000 from a de.riester account
Riester: fully taxed (§22 Nr. 5): 6,000. Rürup: like the statutory pension, 86% for a 2030 start: 5,160 (exempt 840, fixed from 2031)
One €102 lump sum for all pension income; health and care only on the DRV pension (Riester and Rürup are free under KVdR)
